paite: Huan Laban tapate'n, "Jakob in i pa neihsate lamang in, i pa neihsa a kipan hiai thupina tengteng amu,” achih uh Jakob in ana zata hi.
heading: Jakob In Laban Ataisan
english: Jacob heard Laban’s sons’ words, saying, “Jacob has taken away all that was our father’s. He has obtained all this wealth from that which was our father’s.”

paite: Jakob in Laban mel a-en a, ngai in, tuma lam bang in atung ah ahoih nawn kei chih athei hi.
english: Jacob saw the expression on Laban’s face, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.

paite: TOUPA'N Jakob kiang ah, "Na pipute gam ah leh na tanaute kiang ah pai nawnta in. Na kiang a om ding ka hi,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Jacob, “Return to the land of your fathers, and to your relatives, and I will be with you.”

paite: Jakob in mi asawl a, gamlak a aganhon omna ah Rakil leh Leah asamsak a, akiang uah,
english: Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field to his flock,

paite: "Na pa uh mel ka muh in, tuma lam bang in ka tung ah ahoih nawn kei chih ka thei hi. Himahleh ka kiang ah ka pa' Pathian a-om hi.
english: and said to them, “I see the expression on your father’s face, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father has been with me.

paite: Ka theihtawp in na pa uh nna ka sem chih na thei uh.
english: You know that I have served your father with all of my strength.

paite: Himahleh na pa un hon khem a, ka loh lah sawmveitak ahihlamdang a; himahleh Pathian in ka siatna ding akhoih aphal kei hi.
english: Your father has deceived me, and changed my wages ten times, but God didn’t allow him to hurt me.

paite: Gial petmah a gialte na loh ahi ding, achihleh, ganta tengteng in gial petmah a gialte anei uh. Agialte na loh ahi ding achihleh, ganta tengteng in agialte anei zel uhi.
english: If he said, ‘The speckled will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore speckled. If he said, ‘The streaked will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore streaked.

paite: Huchibang in Pathian in na pa gantate alaksak a, kei ahon peta hi.
english: Thus God has taken away your father’s livestock, and given them to me.

paite: "Huan hichi ahong hi a, gantate agai pat lai un, ka mang in ka dak a, ngai in, apa, ganhonte, agialte, gial petmah a gialte, agial a gial iik-iakte ahi uh chih ka mu hi.
english: During mating season, I lifted up my eyes, and saw in a dream, and behold, the male goats which leaped on the flock were streaked, speckled, and grizzled.

paite: Ka mang in Pathian angel in, 'Jakob,' hon chi a; ke'n, 'hiai ah ka om' ka chi hi.
english: The angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob,’ and I said, ‘Here I am.’

paite: Ama'n, 'dak inla, en in, apa gantate tengteng agialte, gial petmah a gialte, agial a gial iik-iakte ahi uh. Laban in na tung a athilhih tengteng ka mu hi.
english: He said, ‘Now lift up your eyes, and behold, all the male goats which leap on the flock are streaked, speckled, and grizzled, for I have seen all that Laban does to you.

paite: Kei, suangphuh a sathau na nilh a, ka kiang a thu na chiamna Bethel, huai Bethel Pathian ka hi. Tu in thou inla, hiai gam a kipan pawt inla, na pianna gam ah pai nawnta in,' " achi hi.
english: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar, where you vowed a vow to me. Now arise, get out from this land, and return to the land of your birth.’”

paite: Rakil leh Leah in adawng ua, akiang ah, "Ka pa uh inn ah koute a ding in tantuan leh gouluah ding a-om lailai a hia?
english: Rachel and Leah answered him, “Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?

paite: Ama'n mikhual bang lel a hon sim hita lou maw? Ahon khawng khinta a, ka man uh lah ane khinta hi.
english: Aren’t we considered as foreigners by him? For he has sold us, and has also used up our money.

paite: Pathian in ka pa uh hauhna alaksak tengteng ei leh i tate a ahi. Pathian in na kiang a agen peuhmah hih in,” achi uhi.
english: For all the riches which God has taken away from our father are ours and our children’s. Now then, whatever God has said to you, do.”

paite: Jakob athou a, sangawngsau tung ah atapate leh azite atuangsak hi.
english: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives on the camels,

paite: Kanaan gam a apa Isak kiang a pai ding in aganta tengteng leh alamkhiak tengteng, aganta muhte, Padan-aram gam a akholte apaipih vek hi.
english: and he took away all his livestock, and all his possessions which he had gathered, including the livestock which he had gained in Paddan Aram, to go to Isaac his father, to the land of Canaan.

paite: Laban, abelam mulmet ding in apawtkhia a; huan Rakil in apa milimte aguksak hi.
english: Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep; and Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father’s.

paite: Siria mi Laban theih louh kal in Jakob in aguk paimangsan a, apaimangsan ding thu ahilh kei hi.
english: Jacob deceived Laban the Syrian, in that he didn’t tell him that he was running away.

paite: Huchi in aneih tengteng toh ataikheta hi. Athou a, Luipi akan a, Gilead tang lam zuan in apaita hi.
english: So he fled with all that he had. He rose up, passed over the River, and set his face toward the mountain of Gilead.

paite: Ani thum ni in Jakob ataikhia chih Laban ahilh uh.
heading: Laban In Jakob Anungdelh
english: Laban was told on the third day that Jacob had fled.

paite: Asanggamte api a, ni sagih lam tan adelh a; Gilead tang ah adelhphata hi.
english: He took his relatives with him, and pursued him seven days’ journey. He overtook him in the mountain of Gilead.

paite: Siria mi Laban kiang ah zan in amang in Pathian ahong a, akiang ah, "Jakob kiang ah asia hi in apha hitaleh bangmah gen lou ding in pilvang in," achi hi. Laban in Jakob adelhphata ade hi.
english: God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.”

paite: Jakob in tang ah apuanin akai khin a; Laban in leng asanggamte toh Gilead tang ah akai uhi.
english: Laban caught up with Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain, and Laban with his relatives encamped in the mountain of Gilead.

paite: Laban in Jakob kiang ah, "Na thilhih bangchidan ahia oi? Ka theih louh kal a na guk paimang a, namsau a lak salte bang mai a ka tanute na pimang?
english: Laban said to Jacob, “What have you done, that you have deceived me, and carried away my daughters like captives of the sword?

paite: Bangziak a hon taimangsan a, hon guk paisan a, nopsaknate toh, late toh, khuangtate toh, kaihgingte toh ka hon khaktheihna ding a na hon hilh louh?
english: Why did you flee secretly, and deceive me, and didn’t tell me, that I might have sent you away with mirth and with songs, with tambourine and with harp;

paite: Ka tute leh ka tanute ka tawp na phal kei. Haihuaitak in thil na hih hi.
english: and didn’t allow me to kiss my sons and my daughters? Now you have done foolishly.

paite: Hon hihse thei ka hi a; himahleh na pa Pathian in tuzan in, 'Jakob kiang ah asia, apha bangmah gen lou ding in pilvang in,' chi in hon houpih hi.
english: It is in the power of my hand to hurt you, but the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.’

paite: Na pa inn na ngaih mahmah tak ziak a, pai ut hi tawk lechin leng bang ding a ka pathiante hon guksak na hia?" achi hi.
english: Now, you want to be gone, because you greatly longed for your father’s house, but why have you stolen my gods?”

paite: Jakob in adawng a, Laban kiang ah, "Ka lauh ziak ahi. Na tanute kei a pan na hon suhsak kha ding ka chi a ahi.
english: Jacob answered Laban, “Because I was afraid, for I said, ‘Lest you should take your daughters from me by force.’

paite: Kuapeuh tung a na pathiante na muhna ahing kei ding. I unaute mitmuh in nang thilte ka kiang a om a-omleh, enchian inla, la in,” achi hi. Rakil in huaite na gu ahih lam Jakob in athei ngal kei a.
english: Anyone you find your gods with shall not live. Before our relatives, discern what is yours with me, and take it.” For Jacob didn’t know that Rachel had stolen them.

paite: Jakob puaninte ah, Leah puaninte ah leh sikhanu nihte puaninte ah Laban alut a; himahleh amu kei. Leah puanin a kipan apawtkhia a, Rakil puanin ah alut hi.
english: Laban went into Jacob’s tent, into Leah’s tent, and into the tent of the two female servants; but he didn’t find them. He went out of Leah’s tent, and entered into Rachel’s tent.

paite: Rakil in milimte ana la a, sangawngsau van lak ah ana koih a, ana tutkhum hi. Laban in apuanin sung tengteng amaisuak vek a, himahleh amu kei hi.
english: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim, put them in the camel’s saddle, and sat on them. Laban felt around all the tent, but didn’t find them.

paite: Ama'n apa kiang ah, "Na ma a ka din ngap louh ziak in ka toupa, heh ke'n aw; numei omdan ngeina ka tung a a-om laitak ahi ngal a," achi hi. Azongzong a, himahleh milimte amuzouta kei hi.
english: She said to her father, “Don’t let my lord be angry that I can’t rise up before you; for I’m having my period.” He searched, but didn’t find the teraphim.

paite: Huchi in Jakob aheh a, Laban asalta hi. Jakob in Laban kiang ah, "Ka tatlekna bang ahia? Ka khelhna bang hi ahia, na hon hichi delh kin?
english: Jacob was angry, and argued with Laban. Jacob answered Laban, “What is my trespass? What is my sin, that you have hotly pursued me?

paite: Ka vante teng na pheklek nung in, na insung van bang na mu a? Ei gel kal a thu akhentheihna ding un ka unaute leh nang unaute ma ah na muh pen hon koihkhia in.
english: Now that you have felt around in all my stuff, what have you found of all your household stuff? Set it here before my relatives and your relatives, that they may judge between us two.

paite: Kum sawmnih vingveng na kiang ah ka omta a; na belampite leh na kelpite'n nou aneikhial ngei kei uh. Na belamhonte lak a apate leng ka ne ngei kei.
english: “These twenty years I have been with you. Your ewes and your female goats have not cast their young, and I haven’t eaten the rams of your flocks.

paite: Gamsa keih leng na kiang ah ka hon tun ngei ngal kei a: amangte sik in ke'n ka thuak zaw zel a; sun a guk hiam, zan a guk hiam lah ka dit na hon phut gige zomah hi.
english: That which was torn of animals, I didn’t bring to you. I bore its loss. Of my hand you required it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.

paite: Hichibang in ka om zel a; sun nisa leh zan khovot in hon hihgim thei mahmah a; ihmut leng ka mu ngei kei.
english: This was my situation: in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from my eyes.

paite: Kum sawmnih sung teng na inn ah ka om a; na tanu nihte loh ding in kum sawm-le-li na nna ka sem a, na gante loh ding in kum guk ka sem nawn a; ka loh ding in kum sawm-le-li na nna ka sem a, na gante loh ding in kum guk ka sem nawn a; ka loh sawmvei na hihlamdang hi.
english: These twenty years I have been in your house. I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your flock, and you have changed my wages ten times.

paite: Ka pa' Pathian, Abraham' Pathian leh Isak' Pathian lauhna ka kiang a om lou hileh houh, tu'n vuaktang lel a hon paisak ngeingei ding na hi. Pathian in ka haksat thuakdan leh ka sepgimdan amu a, tuzan a nang hon sal ahi," achi hi.
english: Unless the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now you would have sent me away empty. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked you last night.”

paite: Laban in adawng a, Jakob kiang ah, "Hiai tanute ka tanute ahi ua, hiai naupangte ka naupangte ahi uh. Hiai gante kei gante ahi ua, na muh tengteng kei a vek ahi uh. Tuni in hiai ka tanute tung ah leh ata neihte uh tung ah bang ka hihthei dia?
heading: Jakob Leh Laban Kithukimna
english: Laban answered Jacob, “The daughters are my daughters, the children are my children, the flocks are my flocks, and all that you see is mine! What can I do today to these my daughters, or to their children whom they have borne?

paite: Kisa in, kei leh nang in thukhun i bawl ding; kei leh nang kikal ah theihpihna hi hen," achi hi.
english: Now come, let’s make a covenant, you and I. Let it be for a witness between me and you.”

paite: Huchi in Jakob in suang ala a, suangphuh in aphut hi.
english: Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.

paite: Jakob in atanaute kiang ah, "Suang lakhawm un,” achi hi. Suang ala ua, achiangkhawm ua, asuang chiankhawm kiang ah an ane uhi.
english: Jacob said to his relatives, “Gather stones.” They took stones, and made a heap. They ate there by the heap.

paite: Laban in huai suang chiankhawm, Jegar-sahadutha asa a; Jakob in bel Galeed asa hi.
english: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, but Jacob called it Galeed.

paite: Laban in, “Hiai suang chiankhawm tu in kei leh nang kikal ah theihpihtu ahi,” achi hi. Huaiziak in amin Galeed chih ahita hi.
english: Laban said, “This heap is witness between me and you today.” Therefore it was named Galeed

paite: "Kikhen a i om hun chiang in TOUPA'N hon veng tuaktuak hen," achih ziak in Mizpah leng achi hi.
english: and Mizpah, for he said, “Yahweh watch between me and you, when we are absent one from another.

paite: "Ka tanute na sukgentheih a, ka tanute lou zi dang na neihleh, ka tanute chih louh kuamah i kiang ah a-om kei na ua, en in, Pathian, kei leh nang kal hon theihpihpa ahi," achi ngal hi.
english: If you afflict my daughters, or if you take wives in addition to my daughters, no man is with us; behold, God is witness between me and you.”

paite: Laban mah in, "Hiai suang chiankhawm en inla, keimah leh nangmah kikal a ka phuh, suangphuh leng en in.
english: Laban said to Jacob, “See this heap, and see the pillar, which I have set between me and you.

paite: Poi kikhoihsak ding in, kei hiai suang pel in na kiang ah ka hong pai kei ding, chih leh nang leng hiai suang chiankhawm leh hiai suangphuh pel in ka kiang ah na hong pai kei ding, chih, hiai suang chiankhawm atheihpihtu hi henla, hiai suangphuh leng atheihpihtu mah hi hen.
english: May this heap be a witness, and the pillar be a witness, that I will not pass over this heap to you, and that you will not pass over this heap and this pillar to me, for harm.

paite: Abraham' Pathian, Nahor Pathian, apa uh Pathian in i kal ah thu khen hen," achi hi. Huchi in Jakob in apa Isak lauhpa min lou in akichiamta hi.
english: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.” Then Jacob swore by the fear of his father, Isaac.

paite: Jakob in tang ah kithoihna alan a, atanaute tanghou ne ding in asamkhawm a; tanghou ane ua, tang ah agiak chiat uhi.
english: Jacob offered a sacrifice in the mountain, and called his relatives to eat bread. They ate bread, and stayed all night in the mountain.

paite: Zingsang in beltak in Laban athou a, atute leh atanute atawp a, avualzawl hi. Laban apaikhia a, amah omna ah akik nawnta hi.
english: Early in the morning, Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them. Laban departed and returned to his place.
